title: python-multipart missing from declared deps
body: The multipart/form-data branch of src/umd/api/routers/sources.py ingest_source (lines 210-229) requires python-multipart to parse request.form(), but python-multipart is NOT declared in pyproject.toml [project.dependencies]. In a clean install the multipart feature raises AssertionError("The `python-multipart` library must be installed to use form parsing.") -> 500. I installed python-multipart==0.0.32 into .venv to verify the new multipart tests (test_multipart_upload_ingest_and_job_completes, test_multipart_missing_file_422). This is an implementation/dependency gap (Plan G scope), not a test issue — tests assert correct behavior once the dep is present.
